summary: Checks your router, NAS and websites by address, port, ping, DNS or heartbeat, with 90 days of history and a status page.
does: Uptime and status checks the things you list, one line each: a web address, words on a page, a port, ping, a DNS record, a certificate, or a heartbeat that a backup or script calls. It says when each is down and sends an alert through Starboard.

It keeps 90 days of response times and uptime, with no database. Checks can be put in groups, with maintenance windows that pause their alerts. Its status page, on your home network, shows each check as up or down without showing addresses.
for: People who want to know quickly that a router, a NAS, a website, a certificate or a backup is still working, without checking each by hand.
needs: Starboard with plug-in API 1.17 or later. An older Starboard is offered Outside services 1.1.4, which checks web addresses only. You write the checks yourself, in Settings, Plug-ins, Uptime and status, Checks.
shows: Five dashboard cards: All checks, Checks (the ones down first), Groups, Response times over 24 hours and Certificates with the days left. Its tab has Checks, Groups and maintenance, alert settings and an Open button for the status page.
